CanonicalKeywords.rationale: `{ CardKeyword.Unplayable }` (Guilty.cs:23) == `is_playable = False`. NOT Eternal -- which matters, because the card's whole mechanic is removing ITSELF from the deck -- and the sim leaves `eternal` False.

AfterCombatEnd.maps_to: NOT PORTED -- GuiltyCard has no after-combat hook (guilty.py)
AfterCombatEnd.issue: `AfterCombatEnd` increments `CombatsSeen` while the card is in the Deck pile and, at 5, calls `CardPileCmd.RemoveFromDeck(this)` (Guilty.cs:45-56). None of it is ported: the sim's `Card` base has no after-combat hook at all, so Guilty NEVER leaves the deck. The sim's docstring justifies this with "the persistent deck, which the sim doesn't model" -- THAT CLAIM IS FALSE, and it is the same false premise as card/debt's "the sim has no gold": `RunState.deck` is the persistent deck, it survives combats, and RunState already has deck-mutating verbs (`add_card`, `transform_card`, run.py:341-469). Observable across a run: in the game Guilty is a temporary curse that deletes itself after five fights; in the sim it is permanent, so every later draw pile is one dead card heavier for the rest of the run. LIVE. Note this is a rule-1 case -- "the sim does not model the hook" is a GAP, never a waiver -- and the deck IS modelled, so it is live rather than dormant. RATIONALE CITES A THIRD FILE (rule 7): sts2_rl/run.py is not hashed by this record.

ctor.issue: CURSE / CURSE / NONE map exactly. The canonical energy cost is -1 in C# and 0 in the sim. `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers` returns early on `_base < 0` (CardEnergyCost.cs:100-103), so the game's unplayable card is immune to every cost modifier and keeps reporting -1; the sim runs a base of 0 through the full modifier chain (cards/base.py:222-232). Only what is READ diverges -- `GetAmountToSpend()` clamps to 0 on both sides. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/ascenders_bane's ctor entry (rule 3). DORMANT: every ported cost reader filters `> 0` or skips `<= 1` (relics/mummified_hand.py:25, potions.py:168, cards/event_cards.py:328), and events/infested_automaton.py:35 filters pool_card_ids(), which holds no curses.

CanonicalVars.maps_to: nothing -- the sim has no counter at all (guilty.py)
CanonicalVars.issue: `new DynamicVar("Combats", 5m)` (Guilty.cs:21) is the COUNTDOWN the card prints, and C# keeps it live: the `[SavedProperty] CombatsSeen` setter writes `DynamicVars["Combats"].BaseValue = 5 - CombatsSeen` (Guilty.cs:25-38), so the card face counts down 5, 4, 3... The sim stores neither the var nor `CombatsSeen`, which follows from the missing AfterCombatEnd. `magic_number` returns None. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/bad_luck's CanonicalVars entry (rule 3): a printed DynamicVar with no `_`-attribute in `_init_vars`, so the sim's printed-number API reports the default and `full_env.card_features` (full_env.py:455-489) encodes the card wrongly for the policy. DORMANT for game fidelity, LIVE for the observation encoder.
